question.text: Any investment made by an AIF on or after July 01, 2025 shall be held in which form?

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that any investment made by an AIF on or after July 01, 2025 shall be held in dematerialised form only, subject to specified exceptions. The Trap: The dematerialised-only rule applies on or after July 01, 2025. Exceptions exist for instruments not eligible for dematerialisation, investments by liquidation schemes that are unavailable in demat form, and other cases specified by SEBI. Note: Apply the exception list strictly as set out in the workbook; default treatment is demat-only.
